title: Cinema seat quantity
brief: Build a seat picker with a range of 1–8 seats, a price of 250 per seat, reset, and a calculated total. Write the full code yourself.

title: Daily reading target
brief: Build a daily reading target from 5–60 pages, with steps of 5 and a reset to 10. Write down what must change before coding.

title: Community event registration
brief: Create a responsive event page with schedule content and an accessible registration form. Use different structure and styles from the guided app.
acceptanceCriteria: Labeled named controls with native validation
Complete keyboard path and visible focus
No horizontal scrolling at narrow widths

title: Support request form
brief: Build a support form with issue type, description, urgency, and contact details. Decide which values are required before coding.
acceptanceCriteria: Fieldset and legend for related choices
Documented Elements, Console, and Network checks
